title: N -W F P Amendment of Certain Laws Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment of Certain Laws Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2003
ACT IX OF 2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT
OF CERTAIN LAWS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West
Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th July, 2003]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis-I/2003/18828,
dated 8-7-2003.----The North West Frontier Province Amendment of Certain
Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on the 28th June, 2003 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 6th July, 2003 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
(Amendment of certain laws) (Amendment) Act. 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Amendment of Certain Laws Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 9 of Act II of 1899

ACT IX OF 2003
ACT IX OF 2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT
OF CERTAIN LAWS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West
Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th July, 2003]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis-I/2003/18828,
dated 8-7-2003.----The North West Frontier Province Amendment of Certain
Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on the 28th June, 2003 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 6th July, 2003 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Amendment of section 9 of
Act II of 1899.--In the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of 1899), in its application to
the North-West Frontier Province, in section 9,--
(i) in clause (d); the full-stop
appearing at the end shall be replaced by a semi colon and the word
"and" shall be added; and
(ii) after clause (d), as so
amended, the following new clause (e) shall be added, namely:
"(e) exempt from payment of
duties either in whole or in part in respect of the instrument executed by
Shaukat Khanum Memorial, Cancer Hospital and Research Centre Lahore, for the
transfer of a house, measuring 54 Marlas donated by Raja Haq Nawaz Kiayani, son
of Raja Ali Akbar Khan resident of Azeem House, Mohallah Bandi Rajgan, Kot
Najibullah, Haripur District. ".

ACT IX OF 2003
ACT IX OF 2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT
OF CERTAIN LAWS)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003.
An Act further to
amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West
Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 8th July, 2003]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis-I/2003/18828,
dated 8-7-2003.----The North West Frontier Province Amendment of Certain
Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on the 28th June, 2003 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 6th July, 2003 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
3. Amendment of section 78 of
Act No.XVI of 1908.-----In the Registration Act, 1908 (XVI of 1908), in its
application to the North-West Frontier Province, in section 78, the full-stop
appearing at the end of the third proviso shall be replaced by a colon and
thereafter the following new proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided also that the
Provincial Government may; by notification in the official Gazette, exempt from
payment of registration fee, either in whole or in part, in respect of the
instrument executed by Shaukat Khanum Memorial, Cancer Hospital and Research Centre
Lahore, for the transfer of a house measuring 54 Marlas donated by Raja Haq
Nawaz Kiyani, son of Raja Ali Akbar Khan resident of Azeem House, Mohallah
Bandi Rajgan, Kot Najibullah, Haripur District.".
